story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix street brawl
story.summaryEn: The Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku was a race of two halves, with a bland opening transformed by a pair of mid-race safety cars and chaos at the lap 36 restart. The melee expanded the list of losers while producing several unlikely winners.
detailZh: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛街头混战中的赢家与输家
原本看似一场在巴库街道上相对乏味的巡游，最终却演变成了一场充满混乱的街头混战。以下是我们对这场精彩纷呈的F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛的赢家与输家盘点
弗兰科·科拉平托，阿尔派，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
这已经不是巴库第一次上演典型的一场比赛两个阶段的戏码了。一道索然无味的主菜，配上比赛中段两次安全车触发的一份放纵的甜点。随着一脚轻轻踩下刹车踏板，第36圈的重启混战让输家名单上的候选人数量翻倍，而赢家名单上则涌现出不少意想不到的英雄。
由于两次安全车重启，比赛的激烈程度远超预期，但这个周末属于拉塞尔。他从始至终表现出统治力，从杆位发车一路领先夺冠，还外加一个大满贯（杆位起步、领跑全场、最快圈速并夺冠）。
对安东内利来说，这是一个混乱的周末，部分原因是他自己造成的，部分原因是缺乏赛道时间让这位意大利车手陷入被动，而拉塞尔则重新找回了本赛季的最佳状态。
是为时已晚，还是恰逢其时迎来意料之外的赛季末逆袭？这可能更多取决于安东内利而非拉塞尔，因为两人差距仍有66分之多。但无论拉塞尔此前需要解决什么问题才能与2026年赛车磨合到位，如今一切正开始顺畅起来。
“我认为这只是因为我对这种新采用的驾驶风格有了更多经验。休赛期之后的每一场比赛，我都感觉自己越来越强，也越来越像原来的自己。这段时间对我来说非常艰难，但我感觉自己已经走了出来。”
比撞上自己队友更糟糕的事情，就是连带着把无辜的旁观者也一起撞了出去。周六晚上，阿尔派车队内部气氛相当不愉快，因为车队为了在争夺第五名的战斗中收复失地所做的所有努力，随着加斯利撞车瞬间烟消云散，全部毁于一旦。
弗兰科·科拉平托在巴库犯下的这次失误，甚至促使他的另一位受害者、世界冠军兰多·诺里斯呼吁对他实施禁赛。这本可以被归结为一时冲动的言论，如果不是这位迈凯伦车手在混采区来回走动时反复多次提及此事的话。
这或许是诺里斯在经历了一个令人沮丧的下午之后的一点小小过激反应？也许吧。但你总会隐约感觉到，科拉平托的大老板弗拉维奥·布里亚托利对此也并不太满意……
"我知道弗兰科已经承担了全部责任，这是他应该做的；事实上，考虑到比赛当时的情形和安全车重启的情况，他刹车实在太晚了。以他这样经验的车手来说，这是一个非常糟糕的操作。"
弗拉维奥。他从来不喜欢拐弯抹角地说话，却常常喜欢“折腾”自己的车手。
迈凯伦车队领队、同为意大利人的安德烈亚·斯特拉说得好：“我猜这事车监会审查，我也相信弗拉维奥也会‘审查’一下。我不确定哪边会更严厉……”
考虑到科拉平托本赛季的表现足够出色，已经赢得了一份到2027年的续约，巴库的那次事故很可能会被原谅。但了解 布里亚托利的人都知道，这事不会被遗忘。
赢家：塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯 / 输家：瓦尔特利·博塔斯
是塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯表现得实在太出色，还是瓦尔特利·博塔斯就是状态低迷？两位凯迪拉克车手之间原本无法解释的巨大性能差距表明，两种因素都占了相当大的成分。
佩雷斯从巴库一开场就令人目眩神迷，重新找回了他“街道赛之王”的旧日名声，把他的凯迪拉克带到了这辆车本不配达到的位置。由于博塔斯毫无速度可言，佩雷斯在第一段（stint）中与两辆奥迪为伴，很快就拉开了与队友之间一个进站（pitstop）的差距，到博塔斯在第28圈驶入维修区时，这个差距已经扩大到52秒。
能够保持在加布里埃尔·博托莱托、随后是卡洛斯·塞恩斯的尾流之中——也就处于超车模式（Overtake Mode）的生效窗口内——一度帮了佩雷斯一把，但这解释不了两人之间如此悬殊的性能鸿沟。
“这是我在巴库最好的周末之一，我从那辆车上榨出了150%的性能，”佩雷斯说。“我们一直在和比我们快一到两秒的赛车缠斗，多亏了超车模式，所以我们在第一段（stint）里始终能咬住他们。”与此同时，博塔斯表示，由于整场只能与阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索缠斗，他必须去找寻答案。希望他能找到一些。
伊萨克·哈贾尔在伤愈复出后迎来了自己代表红牛以来大概最出色的一场比赛表现，其精彩程度完全不亚于他去年在赞德沃特夺得的首个大奖赛领奖台。
哈贾尔带着左手腕骨裂的伤势出战，排位赛获得第四，正赛拿下第三，并且在更有优势的软胎上与队友马克斯·维斯塔潘不相上下。以至于这位法国车手在第一次安全车出动前，正准备向队友发起进攻。
哈贾尔因拳击受伤被迫缺席三周，这对他状态的持续提升来说非常不利，但这位好斗的21岁车手用表现证明自己并不脆弱。
诺里斯完全有理由对科拉平托感到不满，考虑到他的收件箱很可能被辱骂信息淹没，他最好再度远离社交媒体。但事实是，他本来就不该让自己处于会被中游车手撞出比赛的位置。按照他2026年的高标准来看，诺里斯这个周末过得相当糟糕，迈凯伦在低速性能和空气动力学效率上的短板在巴库赛段被暴露得尤为明显。
尽管如此，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里仍然排位第三，本来很有希望登上领奖台，直到他和诺里斯一样在一号弯刹车过度冲出弯道——正是这次失误让诺里斯在安全车出动前掉到了中游。
那么，诺里斯到底出了什么问题？领队斯特拉解释说，这位英国车手一直在应对一个间歇性的燃油喷射问题，这使诺里斯在排位赛和正赛中都损失了直线速度，同时车队也没能解决能量部署的难题。但诺里斯也主动承认了自己的问题。他说：“以我当时拥有的速度，我在赛道上毫无机会，但我确信自己在驾驶方面也有一些做得不够好的地方。我需要看看下次能改进什么。”
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和埃斯特班·奥孔在巴库度过了一个积极的周末。佛朗哥·科拉平托则不然。
现在出现了一个今年在这里很少被提到的名字，而巴库正是他苦苦争取来的将功补过的机会。
一段时间以来，奥孔在哈斯的位置已经是一个公开的秘密。在巴库大奖赛周末之前，有消息传出他的另一只脚也已迈出门槛——这位法国车手宣布自己是一名“自由球员”。在众多候选人当中，据报道法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉最近在波尔蒂芒的一次测试中给车队留下了深刻印象。
当你知道自己留在F1的时间已所剩无几，而车队已经为2027年物色到了更心仪的人选时，继续比赛是一种什么体验？我们永远不会知道。但对奥孔来说，这肯定不好受——他要在一辆表现不稳定、只偶尔能让你展现自身价值的车里，为自己的职业生涯而战。
但在巴库，奥孔的VF-26表现得毫无异常。在机会主义地从队友奥利·比尔曼手中抢下第八名之后，他还在媒体面前强硬地为自己辩护。
“我可以说，那个成绩是我应得的，但其他那些破事不是。我和场上所有人都交过手，我一直都不落下风。我参加过的一系列锦标赛我都赢过。我赢过F3（三级方程式），赢过GP3，也赢过F1（一级方程式）。我能做到，你明白吗？我是场上最出色的车手之一，而且我不怕这么说。”
阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利带来大幅升级后所抱有的任何希望，如今似乎都已化为泡影。本田随后的动力单元升级或许改善了某些方面，但仍与竞争对手相距甚远。
甚至可以说，这辆车的可靠性和 可驾驶性似乎不但没有进步，反而倒退了：兰斯·斯特罗尔已经连续四场大奖赛退赛，费尔南多·阿隆索也不断被各种问题困扰。
但最明显的差距仍然在性能方面：在巴库那条长直道上，阿隆索和斯特罗尔相比梅赛德斯动辄损失高达30公里/小时的尾速。
本田的困境引发了进一步的讨论，即它是否应该从规则中获得更多帮助，因为国际汽联的 追赶机制即将进行新的调整。但鉴于本田今年早些时候已经获得了额外的研发余量，它必须最迟在2027年就展现出一次重大的飞跃。
detailEn: Winners and losers from F1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix street brawl
What looked like a relatively boring parade down the streets of Baku turned into a chaos-filled street brawl. Here are our winners and losers from F1's eventful Azerbaijan GP
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren

Not for the first time, Baku was the epitome of a race of two halves. A flavourless main course washed down with an indulgent dessert, triggered by a mid-race pair of safety cars. With one dab of the brake pedal, the lap 36 restart melee doubled the number of candidates for the loser category, while the list of winners boasts a number of unlikely heroes.

Things got a lot spicier than planned courtesy of the brace of safety car restarts, but this was George Russell's weekend. Imperious from start to finish with a pole-to-flag victory and a grand slam to boot.
On a messy weekend for Kimi Antonelli, partly due to his own making and partly because a lack of track time left the Italian on the back foot, Russell reconnected with his best form this season.

Too little too late, or just in time for an unexpected late-season comeback? That will likely depend more on Antonelli than on Russell, with the gap still a sizeable 66 points. But whatever Russell needed to address to hit his stride with the 2026 cars, it is starting to click.

"I think it’s just having more experience with this sort of new driving style I’ve adopted. And every race since the break, I feel like I’ve gone from strength to strength and I feel like more myself again. It’s been a really tough period for me, but I feel like I’ve come through the other side."

The only thing worse than crashing into your team-mate is taking out innocent bystanders with him. Alpine was not a happy camp to be in on Saturday night after all the hard work the team did to reclaim ground in the battle for fifth disappeared with one fell swoop into Pierre Gasly's sidepod.

Franco Colapinto's Baku blunder even prompted calls from his other victim, world champion Lando Norris, for a race ban. That could be classified as a heat of the moment comment, if it hadn't been for the fact the McLaren driver repeated it a number of times as he roamed the mixed zone.
A slight overreaction after a frustrating afternoon for Norris? Perhaps. But you somehow get the impression Colapinto's big boss Flavio Briatore wasn't all that impressed either...

"I know that Franco has taken full responsibility for it, as he should; in fact he braked far too late considering the context of the race and the safety car restart. It was a very poor move for a driver of his experience."
Flav. Never one to mince his words, often one to mince his drivers.

McLaren team boss and fellow Italian Andrea Stella said it best. "I guess this is being reviewed by the stewards and I'm sure it will be reviewed by Flavio as well. I'm not sure which one is going to be harsher..."
With Colapinto having impressed enough this season to earn a 2027 extension, the Baku incident will likely be forgiven. But knowing Briatore, it will not be forgotten.
Winner: Sergio Perez / Loser Valtteri Bottas
Was Sergio Perez simply outstanding or Valtteri Bottas just lacklustre? The otherwise unexplained chasm in performance between the two Cadillac drivers suggests it's a healthy serving of both.

Perez was mesmerising from the outset in Baku, reconnecting with his old reputation for being a street circuit monster, and putting his Cadillac up where it didn't deserve to be. As Bottas was bereft of pace, Perez entertained the company of the Audis during the first stint, soon pulling out a pitstop gap on his team-mate which ballooned to 52 seconds by the time Bottas peeled into the pits on lap 28.
Being able to stay in Gabriel Bortoleto's and then Carlos Sainz's slipstream - and thus Overtake Mode window - helped Perez for a while, but doesn't explain the huge gulf in performance.

"It's been one of my best weekends in Baku, I managed to get 150% out of that car," Perez said. "We were fighting cars that are a second or two seconds faster than us, due to the overtake mode so we stayed with them throughout the first stint." Meanwhile, Bottas said he would have to look for answers after only being able to fight Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso. One hopes he finds a couple.

Isack Hadjar celebrated his return from his injury layoff with what is likely his strongest performance for Red bull to date, and every bit as impressive as his maiden grand prix podium in Zandvoort last year.

Nursing a fractured left wrist, Hadjar qualified fourth and finished third and proved a match for team-mate Max Verstappen on the favoured soft tyres. So much so that the Frenchman was poised to try and attack his team-mate right before the first safety car came out.
Hadjar's enforced three-week absence following his boxing injury was most unwelcome for his continuing development, but the pugnacious 21-year-old showed he doesn't have a glass jaw.

Norris has every right to be upset with Colapinto, and he would be wise to take another social media sabbatical with his inbox likely flooded with abuse. But the truth is he should never have been in a position to be taken out by midfielders to begin with. Norris has had a particularly poor weekend by his high 2026 standards as McLaren's lack of low-speed performance and aero efficiency hit particularly hard in Baku.

But despite all that, Oscar Piastri still qualified third and looked good value for a podium until he joined Norris in outbraking himself into Turn 1, the transgression that dumped Norris into the midfield before the safety car.

So, what was going on with Norris? Team principal Stella explained the Briton had been dealing with an intermittent fuel injection problem that cost Norris straightline performance both in qualifying and the race, while the team didn't nail its energy deployment puzzle. But Norris also held his hand up. "I had no chance out there with the speed I had, but I'm sure there were some things I wasn't doing well enough in driving," he said. "I need to see what I can improve for next time."
Sergio Perez and Esteban Ocon enjoyed a positive Baku weekend. Franco Colapinto, not so much.
Now there's a name that hasn't featured here very often this year, and Baku was a hard-earned opportunity to make amends.

It has been an open secret for a while that Ocon has had one foot out the door at Haas. Ahead of the Baku weekend, it emerged his other foot had joined suit as the Frenchman declared himself a "free agent". Among a pool of candidates, Ferrari junior Rafael Camara is understood to have dazzled the team during a recent test outing at Portimao.

What is it like trying to perform in F1 knowing you're on borrowed time and your team has found more desirable options for 2027? We will never know. But it can't have been easy for Ocon to deal with, trying to fight for your career aboard in an inconsistent car that only occasionally allows you to show your worth.
But In Baku, Ocon's VF-26 performed without any anomalies. And after he opportunistically snatched eighth away from team-mate Ollie Bearman, he defiantly fought his corner in the press, too.

"I can say I deserve that, not all the rest of the shit. I've raced with everyone out there and I've always been on par. I've won in every championship that I've raced in. I won Formula 3. I won GP3. I won in Formula 1. I can do it, you know? I'm one of the best out there, and I'm not afraid to say it."

Any hopes Aston Martin harboured after its sizeable Hungary upgrade now seem to have vanished. Honda's subsequent power unit upgrade may have improved some areas, but it is still miles away from the competition.

If anything, the car's reliability and driveability appears to have taken a step back rather forward, with Lance Stroll retiring from his fourth straight grand prix and Fernando Alonso continuously plagued by problems, too.
But the most striking deficit remains on the performance front, as Alonso and Stroll routinely shipped up to 30km/h on Baku's long straight compared to Mercedes.

Honda's plight has triggered further debate over whether it deserves more assistance from the regulations as the FIA's ADUO catch-up mechanism is set for fresh tweaks. But with Honda already afforded extra development headroom earlier this year, it must demonstrate a major step forward as early as 2027.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
